title: Teaching Instead of Punishing
learningOutcomes: Understand the key ideas behind teaching instead of punishing and why this topic matters for child development.
Learn practical skills and strategies that help apply teaching instead of punishing in everyday parenting situations.
Build confidence using teaching instead of punishing to support connection, safety, and positive family routines.

modules.title: Understanding the Topic
modules.description: Learn what teaching instead of punishing means and why it matters for child development.

modules.title: Core Skills and Strategies
modules.description: Explore practical skills and strategies for applying teaching instead of punishing in everyday parenting.

modules.title: Real-Life Application
modules.description: See how teaching instead of punishing works in real situations with examples and simple scripts.

modules.title: Reflection and Integration
modules.description: Reflect on your learning and plan how to use teaching instead of punishing in daily family life.

caseworkerSummary: This topic helps parents build practical skills related to teaching instead of punishing. It supports safer, more consistent caregiving by improving understanding, strengthening emotional connection, and reducing stress in daily routines. This topic is suitable for parents who need guidance in applying positive parenting strategies and may benefit families working toward stability, reunification, or improved home safety.
